svg.title: Target: recoverable native Claude skills on Temporal
svg.desc: Target responsibilities, not shipped behavior. A validated skill package runs through the Claude Agent SDK, which owns the agent loop. The Temporal integration governs approvals and supported effects. A replacement Worker restores conversation checkpoints, workspace files and protected claims, and durable approval and tool outcome records before continuing Claude. Known outcomes are reused; uncertain Bash effects park for intervention. Rendered with Cairo.
